instagram.caption:
The coat you feel guilty about.
The Coat and Outerwear Zone in the Entryway. Hold the outerwear you will actually wear this week, at the moment you reach for it.

What done looks like:
1. One coat per person on the rail
2. Gloves together in a single labeled bin on the shelf above
3. Umbrellas standing in the stand
4. At least two hooks left empty

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success coat and outerwear zone.
